purpose: Teach: 法廷/沈黙/欠陥/反射/偏見/中断/農薬/還元

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、法廷、絶対、対応、絶対、弁護士と、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'm serious about this. Take it all the way through the courts with our lawyers. No shortcuts.
lines.style: Firm, steady delivery. Opens with conviction on the first clause. Even pacing, each statement landing with quiet authority. No room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、ご批判への、絶対、沈黙、絶対、せず、絶対、説明、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We won't ignore criticism. We'll respond with clear explanation and transparency.
lines.style: Respectful, steady cadence. Slightly formal register reflecting the gravity of the moment. Each commitment lands with quiet assurance. No hemming or hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 製品の、本気で、絶対、欠陥、絶対、絶対、なきよう、絶対、品質管理、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Quality control needs to be absolute. No defects get through. Not one.
lines.style: Measured but uncompromising. Light stress on the word 'absolute' — matter-of-fact, not angry. Cool and direct, like someone who knows this will be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の、本気で、絶対、反射、絶対、素材、絶対、活用、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making full use of reflective materials in our new product line, and we're moving forward with that approach.
lines.style: Calm professional report. Speaking at a steady tempo, like someone sharing an update they've already verified. Small nod of certainty in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様への、本気で、絶対、偏見、絶対、ない、絶対、サービス、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Customer service has to be free of bias. Full stop. Make that standard across the board.
lines.style: Direct and final. No question in the intonation. Speaks as if laying down a fact rather than issuing an order, which makes it heavier.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業の、本気で、絶対、中断、絶対、なきよう、絶対、リスク管理、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're strengthening our risk management to ensure business continuity and prevent any disruption.
lines.style: Competent briefing tone. Speaking slightly faster than before — a man through a rehearsed list, but not rushed. Confidence built on preparation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気for、絶対、農薬、絶対、を扱わない、絶対、姿勢、絶対、明確にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make our position crystal clear: this company will not handle pesticides under any circumstances.
lines.style: Slow and deliberate. Each phrase gets weight. Opens with slight emphasis on 'crystal clear.' The finality of someone drawing a line that won't be moved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域社会への、本気で、絶対、還元、絶対、継続しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We continue to give back to the community and we'll keep that commitment strong.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Slightly slower than the previous updates — reflective rather than urgent. Voice softens just enough to signal this is a value, not just a directive.
